from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import json,hashlib,requests
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_bank_accepted_bill_discount_source_qualification_v1'
assert not (OUT/'public_script_receipts.json').exists(),'公开页面脚本已取，不重复。'
records=json.loads((OUT/'catalog_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
market=next(x for x in records if x['source_id']=='market')
wanted=['shcpe-data.js','shcpe-inner.js','shcpe-request.js']
urls={name:next(url for url in market['javascript_files'] if url.endswith('/'+name)) for name in wanted}
def get(task):
    name,url=task;item={'source_id':name,'url':url,'attempts':1,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()}
    try:
        r=requests.get(url,timeout=(10,25),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 historical-source-research'})
        path=OUT/'sources'/name
        with path.open('xb') as f:f.write(r.content)
        item.update(status_code=r.status_code,final_url=r.url,path=path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),bytes=len(r.content),successfully_received=r.status_code==200)
    except requests.RequestException as error:item.update(successfully_received=False,error_type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error)[:800])
    item['completed_at']=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
    return item
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as executor:receipts=list(executor.map(get,list(urls.items())))
with (OUT/'public_script_receipts.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:
    json.dump(receipts,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\n')
for item in receipts:print(json.dumps(item,ensure_ascii=False))
print('额外官方请求累计6/12。仅读取市场页直接引用的公开脚本，未调用收益模型。')
